Fellowships Programs
ICFO offers fellowships for PhD studies at the institute using a variety of funding mechanisms, competitive projects or grants awarded to ICFO as a whole or to its research groups as well as agreements or contracts with other institutions. Regardless of the specific funding mechanism, ICFO PhD Fellows will be fully funded throughout the entire PhD Program.
All PhD Fellowships on offer are awarded through our standardized admissions procedure. A rolling call with periodic deadlines is always open for candidates motivated to do a PhD in any eligible ICFO group. Each call includes detailed information on the available fellowships and candidates applying to them are considered for all fellowships on offer for which they are eligible. If you are interested in opportunities for PhD student positions, please browse each Group Home under our Research pages, check the open calls and available group projects and go to the Job Openings & Fellowships page to apply through the corresponding calls.
Fellowship Programs
Severo Ochoa Fellowships
Severo Ochoa fellowships are offered by ICFO to outstanding PhD candidates to pursue their PhD studies in any of our Research Groups.

Previous Fellowship Programs
FLIGHT
FLIGHT is a 60-month MCSA COFUND doctoral program that aims at recruiting outstanding PhD students to carry out ambitious PhD-projects at ICFO in one of 3 tracks: Enhanced, Industrial or Clinical.

Severo Ochoa Excellence fellowships are offered by ICFO to outstanding PhD candidates to pursue their PhD studies in any of our Research Groups.

ENLIGHTEN is a Marie Sklowdowska-Curie-COFUND action under the European Union’s Horizon 2020 research and innovation program, which will be awarding a total of 20 fellowships to outstanding graduate students under grant agreement No 847517.

PREBIST
PREBIST is a Marie Sklowdowska-Curie-COFUND action under the European Union’s Horizon 2020 research and innovation program, coordinated by the Barcelona Institute of Science and Technology (BIST) together with the research centers that make up the BIST scientific community (ICFO, ICIQ, ICN2, IFAE & IRB Barcelona). PREBIST awarded a total of 28 fellowships to outstanding PhD candidates under grant agreement No 754558.
